specs.label: Specification
specs.heading: Specification
specs.note: Neck size and weight depend on the size. <link>Check them in the size chart</link>.

sizes.label: Sizes
sizes.heading: Sizes
sizes.intro: Measure the neck at its widest point and add 2–3 cm of slack. The dog's weight is only a guide — the measurement decides.
sizes.footnote: Highlighted rows are the sizes this model comes in. Collar weight refers to the version in that size.

shipping.label: Shipping and returns
shipping.heading: Shipping and returns
shipping.shippingBody: Ships within 24 h on business days. Choose courier or parcel locker — you pick the delivery method in the cart.
shipping.costBody: Free shipping from {amount}. Below that, the cost depends on the carrier and is shown in the cart.
shipping.returnsBody: 60 days to return or exchange a size. Stitching and hardware carry a 2-year warranty.

compatibility.label: Compatibility
compatibility.heading: Compatibility
compatibility.intro: Measure the module housing where it passes through the strap. The transmitter brand doesn't matter — housing width is what counts.
compatibility.footnote: The module mounts on guide rails; the electrodes must stay in constant contact with the skin.

care.label: Care
care.heading: Care
care.step1: Hand wash in lukewarm water, no bleach and no fabric softener.
care.step2: Dry away from radiators. High heat stiffens the webbing and ruins the hook-and-loop.
care.step3: Rinse the hardware with clean water after work in mud and salt, then wipe it dry.
care.step4: Check the stitching at the buckle every few weeks. Frayed edging means replacement, not repair.
